menu.don.brightest.title: The Brightest
dialogue.don.brightest.1: You stand among the graves of my people.
dialogue.don.brightest.2: I have brought you to this {#FFE0B2}forgotten world{/}... because only {b}you{/} can help me.
dialogue.don.brightest.3: The {#FFEE88}light{/} they left behind still lingers, waiting to be {pop}awakened{/}.
dialogue.don.brightest.5: And my {pop}people{/} shall walk this world once more.
journal.don.empty: No discoveries yet. TODO Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet.
journal.don.mystic_brazier: Mystic Brazier — Works with the mystical component can be lit with the sealed singularity, though it burns with soul fire.
journal.don.mystical_monocle: Mystical Monocle — This doesn't look good on me, very useful when it comes to scouting out enlightened areas.
journal.don.singularity_crystal: Singularity Crystal — Scary crystal, sucks in light around it, gives off an weird aura.
journal.don.light_weaver: Light Weaver — A construct? It seems hurt, however they are still very cute.
journal.don.sealed_singularity: Sealed Singularity — Very useful, somehow it can contain the singularity with just steel.
journal.don.portable_star: Portable Star — A powerful block, It burns hot, but comfortably.
journal.don.soul_light: Soul Light — Seems to carry a sliver of mystical component, which has, some concerning implications.
journal.don.light_urn: Light Urn — They shine like the Brightest, however, they are silent, it feels weird...
journal.don.brightest: Brightest — Know it all, talkative fella, very useful though.
journal.don.singularity_geode: Singularity Geode — Scary crystal, sucks in light around it, gives off an weird aura.
journal.don.glowmark: Glowmark — An enchantment with an effect similar to the present in spectral arrows.
journal.don.light_drain: Light Drain — Gives off an eery aurea, similar to those crystals... I hope to never be on the receiving end of it.
journal.don.amethyst: Amethyst — Apparently and old singularity crystal? I wouldn't believe it if I hadn't seen it change before my eyes.
